title: Swarm: Consul raft-leader failover (RTO measured)
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster swarm --direction consul-leader --yes`. SSH-stops consul on the discovered Consul raft leader, polls a different manager until raft elects a new leader, then restarts the original (auto-recovery).

observe.what: original primary -> new primary (a different manager), RTO ~2s, recovery=recovered; timeline table of the 5 instants

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.FailoverAsync dispatches --direction to the reused FailoverTestService.RunConsulLeaderAsync (stop consul on the leader, measure re-election RTO, auto-recover).
